<title level="1" right="Action">[Snatch](/Actions.aspx?ID=2797) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 95

</column>

---

The roc Strikes a creature with its talon and then attempts to [Grab](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) the creature. If the Grab is successful, the roc then [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) up to half its speed, carrying that creature along with it.
